headline: ElevenLabs + Twilio Power Voice Call Applications with AI
summary: Developers can now build AI-powered voice experiences, from personalized voicemails to real-time translation, using ElevenLabs' TTS and Twilio's telephony.
details: Building interactive, AI-powered voice applications is now more accessible than ever. Twilio provides the core infrastructure for making and receiving voice calls, while ElevenLabs offers advanced text-to-speech (TTS) and voice cloning capabilities.
This integration allows developers to create a wide range of applications, including personalized voicemail assistants and real-time language translation services that can be accessed over the phone.
The process involves setting up a Twilio phone number to direct incoming calls to a webhook. This webhook, powered by a Flask endpoint, processes the call and interacts with ElevenLabs' API.

ElevenLabs' API can convert plain text into speech, providing a URL to an MP3 file. Developers can use default voices or even upload audio samples to create custom, cloned voices that sound remarkably human.

The article provides a practical guide to building a minimal, functional example, culminating in a reusable Flask endpoint deployable on any cloud provider. This significantly lowers the barrier to entry for voice-first AI app development.

Previously, creating such applications required deep knowledge of DSP libraries and self-hosted TTS engines. The combination of Twilio and ElevenLabs simplifies this process, enabling developers to focus on the AI experience itself.

headline: Focus Friend app helps Android users escape phone addiction with gamified timer
summary: This app uses a virtual pet and rewards to encourage users to stay off their phones, transforming productivity.
details: Many Android users struggle with phone addiction, finding that built-in tools like Digital Wellbeing are too easy to bypass. This often leads to a cycle of downloading productivity apps only to abandon them for endless scrolling.
Focus Friend offers a novel solution by gamifying the Pomodoro technique. Instead of simply blocking apps, it introduces a virtual pet, a 'Bean,' that users care for by completing focus sessions.

During a 25-minute work session, the Bean knits. Completing the session rewards the user with 'socks' to decorate the Bean's virtual room. However, exiting the app early causes the knitting to unravel, disheartening the Bean and forfeiting rewards.

The app's 'Deep Focus' mode, requiring Overlay and Usage permissions, acts as a strict guard. It prevents users from opening other apps by displaying a full-screen prompt from the Bean, ensuring uninterrupted work sessions.

This gamified approach, coupled with the 'Deep Focus' mode, transforms the Android phone from a source of distraction into a powerful productivity tool. Users can achieve extended flow states and build a rewarding digital environment for their virtual companion.
